svg.title: Measurement plan spindle shaft (example)
svg.text: Measurement plan – spindle shaft: which feature is checked on which instrument (limits = twin example values)
Rule: instrument uncertainty ≤ 10–20 % of the tolerance · measure at 20 ±0.5 °C after ≥ 4 h soak · decision rule ISO 14253-1 (guard band = U)
in-process gauge + indicating micrometer 0.5 µm, master ring
Runout to A-B: seats / nose face / shoulders
form tester (axis A-B from both seats) or centres + 0.2 µm probe
HSK-A63 taper plug gauge + thin marking blue
gauge fixture set on a master
thread ring gauges GO/NO-GO, gauge nut + dial
stylus tester, λc 0.8 mm, 2 µm tip
Lengths, shoulders, key seats, M6 holes
UCI on the part; coupon: HV0.5 traverse + metallography
Uncertainty example (seat Ø70, micrometer): u = √(0.14² + 0.30² + 0.15² + 0.23²) = 0.43 µm → U = 0.87 µm = 11 % of IT4 (8 µm) → guard band: accept ±3.13 µm.
Gauge capability: Cg = 0.2·T/(6s) = 2.22, Cgk = 1.94 (≥ 1.33) · %GRR = 6σ/T = 26 % → conditionally acceptable – improve fixture / soak.
Values = twin example values · not to scale · 2026-11
